items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he had hired Maurice Purtle to play drums

ctx.x: Well, I went out there, and he had hired Maurice Purtle to play drums, they had put him under contract -- he said he couldn't wait.
Yeah, we called him Moe Purtle.

Right, and they were playing the old Orchard Beach, another one of those places. Another one of my expeditions there. So I was very unhappy about making a comeback after being ill, and I went home, and about two or three days later, I got a call from Tommy Dorsey's manager, who was with a real great band at that time at the old Pennsylvania Hotel Roof Garden.
